title: Old News (Prod. Lexi Banks)
lyrics:
OLD NEWS
VERSE 1

They like, Kazon where you been at?  
I been finding peace in being unseen  
Had to disappear just to see clearly  
I don’t need the praise, I know who sees me  

Used to need applause, now I move freely  
Now I’m more concerned with who I’m pleasing  
They liked me better back when I was needing  
Set a couple boundaries, now I’m tweaking?  

I can’t let opinions be my compass  
Too many backseat drivers in my comments  
I don’t need consensus, I got conscience  
They can keep the praise, I’ll keep my promise  

I quit giving updates, watch the outcome  
Funny, now it’s working and they like, “How come?”  
Same God I was trusting when the doubt come  
They ignored the recipe, now the sauce done  

So, come and get a taste  
I’m out in heaven for eternity, check the time and place  
One-way ticket, I don’t need a return date  
Couldn’t earn the trip, guess who paid the way?


CHORUS

You keep bringing up a version that got laid down  
That was 2016, things changed now  
I ain’t hiding who I was, I just changed routes  
I was finding my way, I know the Way now  

You can quote my past, it don’t offend me  
Can’t use old evidence against me  
All that dirt you found? He already cleansed me  
Case already closed, you can’t condemn me  


VERSE 2

Facts… that’s old news…  
Need to fact-check the lies they done told you  
They breaking news on what I already broke through  
They got headlines, they don’t know the whole truth  

Hiding evidence, some things they ain’t show you  
Before you pick a side, know who you close to  
Some will sell you lies just ’cause they know you  
Two sides to a story, better know two  

I don’t need to argue, let the fruit talk  
Different fruit when you get to the root cause  
Got a new direction and a new walk  
If you’re looking for the old me, you’re years off


CHORUS

You keep bringing up a version that got laid down  
That was 2016, things changed now  
I ain’t hiding who I was, I just changed routes  
I was finding my way, I know the Way now  

You can quote my past, it don’t offend me  
Can’t use old evidence against me  
All that dirt you found? He already cleansed me  
Case already closed, you can’t condemn me

credits.name: Kazon
